messages:
Leah: FYI eu-west-1 hitting ENI attach limits + kubelet churn, tons of Pending GPU pods. Seeing scale-up attempts + immediate failure. :grimacing:
Ibrahim: grabbing autoscaler logs now. may be a mix of tiny short-lived GPU jobs and AZ imbalance.
Claire: I see CI and a research sweep both kicked off ~11:58. labels: team=ci, team=research. Roughly 380 pods created over 5min.
Ibrahim: autoscaler excerpt:
Ibrahim: ```2026-03-18T11:59:04Z cluster-autoscaler: scaleUp: nodegroup=eu-gpu-prod size=8 -> 11
2026-03-18T11:59:16Z cloudprovider/aws: CreateInstance failed: AttachNetworkInterface: NetworkInterfaceLimitExceeded
2026-03-18T11:59:16Z cluster-autoscaler: Failed to increase nodes for reason: EnisLimit
2026-03-18T12:00:05Z cluster-autoscaler: Found 142 unschedulable pods
```
Leah: thanks. ops-bot triggered alert for eni-utilization > 90% in subnet-a. Also some kubelet restart loops on new spot nodes.
Claire: quick containment options: 1) throttle the offending jobs (patch CronJob/Job controllers), 2) add a temporary nodepool with instances that have higher ENI-per-instance ratio, 3) pause spot scaling if it's causing unstable nodes.
Ibrahim: agree. Also set CA flag --max-node-provision-rate=1 and --scale-down-unneeded-time=10m to avoid jumpy behavior.
Leah: I'm patching the research Job: `kubectl patch job batch-sweep-2026-03-18 -p '{"spec":{"parallelism":3}}'` and set `--concurrency-policy=Forbid` on the CronJob. applied.
deploy-bot: created nodegroup eu-gpu-denseeni size 0->2 instanceType=g5dn.12xlarge (higher ENI) :rocket:
ops-bot: muted alert group eni-utilization-eu-west for 15m per incident runbook.
Claire: adding taint to prod nodes to keep research off them: `kubectl taint nodes -l pool=prod research-evict=true:NoSchedule`
Ibrahim: rolling action: cordon/evict low-priority pods from old spot nodes to encourage scheduling on new dense-eni pool. Using priorityClass to avoid evicting prod.
Leah: after patches Pending gpu pods dropped from ~210 -> 36 in 8m. ENI attach errors reduced. kubelet restarts persisted on two spot nodes; cordoned and draining them.
Claire: cost note: g5dn are pricey; ops approves short-lived use to mitigate wasted retries. Capture cost delta and revert in 4-6 hours.
Ibrahim: we should also deploy a lightweight admission check to limit `parallelism` for jobs labeled team=research and team=ci while we discuss quotas. Filing INFRA-4921.
Leah: created INFRA-4921 with proposed limits + autoscaler flag changes. Adding timeline + metrics.
deploy-bot: scaled nodegroup eu-gpu-denseeni to 3 after spot allocation succeeded.
ops-bot: alert: ENI attach errors: 0 in last 5m. eni-utilization at 68%.
Claire: follow-ups: 1) apply cluster-level concurrency quotas via ResourceQuota/LimitRange or a custom admission controller, 2) catalog instance ENI capacity and prefer denser ENI SKUs for future burst pools, 3) add graceful retry/backoff to our job launcher to avoid immediate resubmits.
Ibrahim: will upstream autoscaler flag recommendation: `--max-node-provision-rate=2 --node-group-auto-discovery=...` to prod defaults and document in Runbook.
Leah: I'll coordinate with Research to change their launcher to reuse long-lived GPU sessions (medium-term).
postmortem-bot: created postmortem stub in #postmortems/incident-2512345678 with checklist.
Claire: last check: cluster stable, Pending down to 4, nodepool eu-gpu-denseeni handling new pods. I'll leave this thread open for 2h to watch for regressions. thanks all :heart:
